profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon, a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, trading under the ticker AMZN. The company's most recently reported annual revenue was $716,924,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, as filed in a 10-K. The harvested content focuses specifically on Amazon SageMaker, which the company describes as "the center for all your data, analytics, and AI," offering an integrated environment for machine learning, generative AI, data processing, and SQL analytics within a single development platform called SageMaker Unified Studio.

AWS tracks two AI products on this site. Amazon SageMaker covers the full ML lifecycle, including model monitoring, bias detection, and explainability tools, and incorporates sub-capabilities such as HyperPod, JumpStart, and MLOps tooling, alongside Amazon Q Developer, which the company describes as a generative AI assistant for software development tasks including data discovery, model building, SQL query generation, and pipeline management. AWS Bedrock is a managed foundation model API service with IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and a component called AgentCore for agent orchestration.

The held facts note 47 law exposure entries associated with Washington state, though no specific cases are recorded in the data. AWS has a verified presence in this site's registry, with its CIK recorded as 0001018724, and no MCP server entries are associated with the company at this time.
